The raft zither is a set of single-string tube zithers joined together in raft fashion; it belongs to the zither family and is related to the board zither. Its flat surface forms the base for many strings, each tube giving a different note, so that several instruments become one instrument of many notes. The Congo has the Totombito zither, and Nigeria and East Africa have similar examples; the Dhimar of Nepal make tubes from a bunch grass and join them into the tunjaai, each tube carrying an upper and a lower string, and it hangs from the shoulder while both hands play it with plectra. The Hornbostel–Sachs number is 313.
筏狀箏由多支單弦管箏連成，每支管箏音高不同，弦以琴橋抬高，筏面承弦。初學可先辨認: The raft zither is made of several single-string tube zithers joined together, each with a different pitch, the strings raised by bridges and the strings resting on the raft surface. A beginner can first identify the pitch of each tube and check where the strings and bridges lie. The Nepalese tunjaai hangs from the shoulder, each tube has an upper and a lower string, and the player plucks with both hands at once; in practice, take the upper and lower strings separately first and then bring them together. For examples such as the Congo Totombito the source gives no playing position, so only the many-tube, many-note structure can be described.
筏狀箏的材質記載有限：尼泊爾迪馬爾人以花束草製作管狀琴，再連結成 tunjaai: The materials of the raft zither are sparsely recorded: the Dhimar of Nepal make the tube instruments from a bunch grass and then join them into the tunjaai; the sounding body is the strings, which may be tied to the tube or cut from the tube itself and raised on bridges. For the examples from the Congo, Nigeria and East Africa the source does not state the materials of the body, strings, bridges or plectra.
筏狀箏的音色具有清澈透亮的特質，帶有輕盈而靈動的聲感。由於採用管狀結構作為弦的基: The raft zither has a clear, transparent timbre with a light, nimble sound. Because the strings are seated on tube structures, each tube forms its own resonating chamber, which makes the timbre both pure and carrying, not as warm and heavy as a traditional board zither. Its range is wide: built from several single-string tube zithers, it covers the low register up to the high. Its resonance is particular, the air vibrating inside each tube reinforcing the resonance of every note and giving the sound more depth. Against the harp, the raft zither sounds crisper and more brisk; against the piano, it lacks the piano's large volume but has the gentle warmth particular to a regional instrument. Its overall sound lies between the traditional string instrument and modern percussion.
筏狀箏起源於東南亞地區，是傳統弦樂器發展的獨特產物。這種樂器將多個單弦管狀箏連接: The raft zither comes from Southeast Asia and is a distinctive product of the development of traditional string instruments. It joins several single-string tube zithers into one unified platform, each tube giving a different pitch, which creates rich musical layers. Its appearance reflects the inventiveness of ancient craftsmen, who used simple bamboo or wooden tubes to make a portable instrument of many notes.
隨著時間推移，筏狀箏的製作工藝不斷完善，從最初的結構簡單發展為音色更加複雜多變的: Over time the making of the raft zither was refined, from a simple structure at first to forms with a more complex and varied timbre. Its design follows the same idea as the board zither, but the raft zither's composite structure offers more flexible musical possibilities. In the traditional music of Southeast Asia it gradually became an important instrument, with a place in folk ritual, folk performance and music education, and as cultures exchanged it spread to neighbouring regions and became part of the music of several peoples.
